name: diag
doc:
diag: metrics (Prometheus text), tracing (OpenTelemetry-compatible
spans propagated through the task context, W3C traceparent), CPU and
heap profiles in pprof format (docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 5). See
sema/stdsrc.rs for the rules of these sources. Global state (registry,
tracer) lives in the runtime's slot map (rtSlots, guarded by rtLock);
the current span is a task-context frame with the reserved key -102.

items.name: AddExporter
items.doc: Adds an exporter for finished spans.
items.summary: Adds an exporter for finished spans.

items.name: CurrentSpan
items.doc: The current span of the task (nil if none).
items.summary: The current span of the task (nil if none).

items.doc: Prometheus' default buckets (seconds).

items.name: EnableRuntimeMetrics
items.doc:
Adds the runtime metrics (zell_live_objects, zell_allocations_total,
zell_tasks, zell_scheduler_queue_length, zell_scheduler_workers,
zell_heap_inuse_bytes, zell_heap_retained_bytes,
zell_heap_released_bytes) to PrometheusText.
items.summary: Adds the runtime metrics (zell_live_objects, zell_allocations_total, zell_tasks, zell_scheduler_queue_length, zell_scheduler_workers, zell_heap_inuse_bytes, zell_heap_retained_bytes, zell_heap_released_bytes) to PrometheusText.

items.summary: Live objects by type, most live first (empty without ZELL_DIAG_HEAP=1 or --leak-check).

items.doc:

a traceparent header) and makes it current: `var s =
diag.StartSpan("load"); defer s.End()`.
items.summary: Starts a span as a child of the current span (or a remote parent from a traceparent header) and makes it current: `var s = diag.StartSpan("load"); defer s.End()`.

items.name: Span
items.doc:
A span (OpenTelemetry data model): ids are lowercase hex (TraceId 16
bytes, SpanId 8), times are Unix nanoseconds. StartSpan makes it the
current span of the task until End.
items.summary: A span (OpenTelemetry data model): ids are lowercase hex (TraceId 16 bytes, SpanId 8), times are Unix nanoseconds.

members.name: Remote
members.doc: The span came from a traceparent header (another process).
members.summary: The span came from a traceparent header (another process).

members.name: SetAttribute
members.doc: SetAttribute sets (or replaces) attribute key.
members.summary: SetAttribute sets (or replaces) attribute key.

members.doc: SetStatus sets the status of the span and its message.
members.summary: SetStatus sets the status of the span and its message.

members.name: RecordError
members.doc:
Records err: status Error with its message, and the attribute

members.summary: Records err: status Error with its message, and the attribute exception.message.

members.name: End
members.doc:
Ends the span (once), restores the context of before StartSpan and
hands the span to the exporters.
members.summary: Ends the span (once), restores the context of before StartSpan and hands the span to the exporters.

members.name: Duration
members.doc: Duration in nanoseconds (0 before End).
members.summary: Duration in nanoseconds (0 before End).

members.name: Traceparent
members.doc: The W3C traceparent header value: 00-<trace>-<span>-01.
members.summary: The W3C traceparent header value: 00-<trace>-<span>-01.
